# 001 — Example Project

Illustrative project folder used by the `zettelkasten-mcp` test suite. The project's README is the only file inside `projects/*/` that gets indexed — artifacts and sub-notes are ignored by default.

## Goal

Demonstrate how the server treats a project's README as a first-class note alongside permanent and literature notes.

## Status

- [x] README in place with valid frontmatter
- [ ] Anything beyond this README is purposely absent
